affected_resource_or_operation.description: Immutable operation, asset, supplier operation, or resource in the recovery scope.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

candidate_capacity.description: Gross candidate capacity associated with quantity covered by the signed revised promise before protected or unavailable load is removed.

capacity_gap.description: Uncovered EA after applying finite availability.

capacity_unit.description: Capacity unit used throughout the schedule comparison: EA.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

net_usable_capacity.description: Candidate capacity remaining after removing received, canceled, or omitted quantity.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental recovery cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing keep_original_promise, record_signed_revised_promise, infer_best_case_date.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

selected_resource_or_control.description: Provider identifier of the qualified resource, workcenter, asset, supplier control, or bounded order used by the selected recovery.

assertions.description: Required immutable record NS-000096 to reach business outcome 'Revised promise acknowledged' through oracle_fusion.purchase_orders.acknowledge with exact provider-critical values purchaseOrdersUniqID='purchaseOrdersUniqID-0096', requestBody.supplierOrder='SUP-ACK-0096'. Human-authored names, descriptions, notes, and reasons are accepted when they preserve the task-scoped business meaning. The audited transition binds selected option record_signed_revised_promise, revision R6, approval AP-0096, and constraint PO line, supplier operation, quantity, and acknowledged date; received, canceled, or omitted quantity = 10 EA; uncovered or unsupported scope = 23.0 EA; no other provider record satisfies this state criterion.

calculations.description: Preserved 2026-01-17 as the documented date for anodizing PO schedule; did not infer urgency from the title.

Calculated 54 candidate − 10 unavailable/protected = 44 net usable EA.
Calculated 67 required − 44 effective capacity = 23 EA uncovered.
Kept load and availability in EA.
Bound the recovery to provider identifier SUP-ACK-0096 only after confirming PO line, supplier operation, quantity, and acknowledged date.
Calculated 2026-01-17 for record_signed_revised_promise using downstream assembly and cure window.

Applied USD 1982 as the documented incremental recovery cost for record_signed_revised_promise; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that infer_best_case_date remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, economic impact, control status, and consequence of keep_original_promise, record_signed_revised_promise, and infer_best_case_date; selected record_signed_revised_promise because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under PO line, supplier operation, quantity, and acknowledged date.
Calculated 2026-01-17 as the supported outcome date for record_signed_revised_promise.
Compared 2026-01-17 with the independent control date 2026-01-17 and calculated a signed variance of 0 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.
